answer.reason: The verses tell two main events of Jehoiachin's life: his captivity in Babylon and his release and honoring there.

clauses.english: was carried away captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar
clauses.quote: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon

clauses.english: was lifted out of prison and given a place of honor at the king of Babylon's table
clauses.quote: did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison

doubts: 2CH 36:9 gives his age as eight, against eighteen in 2KI 24:8; not used.
JER 22:24-30 pronounces judgment on Coniah, which is a prophecy and not an event, so it was left out.
Verses naming Jeconiah or Jechonias (JER 24, 27, 28, 29, 37; EST 2:6; MAT 1) were used only as context, since they add nothing beyond the captivity.
